cards.name: Eon
cards.text: Apex Predator. Dusk: shuffle this into your deck with -1 strength.
Flight. Roar: put an animal from your opponent's Remove Pile into your hand.

cards.name: Black Swan
cards.text: Whenever you draw Black Swan, your opponent discards a random card.

cards.name: Hawk
cards.text: Flight. Roar: remove an adjacent enemy of strength 3 or less.

cards.name: King Cobra
cards.text: Roar: choose an adjacent enemy. At the start of your next turn, remove it.

cards.name: Magpie
cards.text: Flight. Roar: steal a card from your opponent's hand, then discard a card.

cards.name: Black Mamba
cards.text: Roar: remove an adjacent enemy of strength 5 or less.

cards.name: Python
cards.text: Has +1 strength for each removed animal.

cards.name: Egg Eater
cards.text: Has +2 strength for each removed Egg.

cards.name: Mosquito
cards.text: Flight. Roar: give an adjacent enemy -2 strength.

cards.name: Raven
cards.text: Flight. Roar: draw 3 cards, then shuffle 2 cards back.

cards.name: Bird Egg
cards.text: Roar: Scout a Bird. Next turn, remove this and Scout a Bird.

cards.name: Snake Egg
cards.text: Roar: draw a Snake. In 2 turns, remove this and draw 2 Snakes.
